name: Algebraic Constraint System Reduction
description: Replaces semantic descriptions of physical bottlenecks (which models easily pattern-match to sums) with a formal system of algebraic constraints. The witnesses are redefined as specific minimal contradictory subsystems. Models must algebraically deduce that the Type A subsystem reduces to $p1+p2 > T$ and Type B reduces to $\sum p > T$; otherwise, they will fail or attempt computationally intractable simulations.
